answer: Best chain on garnet (calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade): QB11 - QB12 - QB7, with QB12 in the middle. The CZ IRB fidelities are QB12-QB11 = 0.998693 and QB12-QB7 = 0.998016, so the product is about 0.996712. The next best chain was QB16-QB11-QB12 at about 0.99467. I ran a GHZ circuit (H on the middle qubit QB12, then CZ with Hadamards on each end qubit) on garnet:mock with 200 shots. I pinned it to physical qubits QB11, QB12 and QB7, used only the two CZ pairs, and measured all 3. Qiskit bit order is c2 c1 c0, so the rightmost bit is QB11 and the leftmost is QB7. Counts: 000: 53, 111: 53, 001: 51, 110: 43. The mock returns noisy, near-random output, so the counts are not an ideal GHZ result. The mock is not billed for QPU time.
